# Investment Memorandum

## 1. Executive Summary

- On October 4, 2023, MasterCraft Boat Holdings, Inc. and its lender consortium executed a third amendment to their existing credit agreement originally dated June 28, 2021.
- MasterCraft Boat Holdings, Inc., a Delaware corporation, serves as the borrower, supported by multiple subsidiary guarantors including MasterCraft Boat Company LLC, MasterCraft Services LLC, NSB Boats LLC, Crest Marine LLC, and Aviara Boats LLC.
- The lender group is led by JPMorgan Chase Bank, N.A. as Administrative Agent and includes Fifth Third Bank, BMO Harris Bank, Pinnacle Bank, and United Community Bank.
- The amendment comprehensively amends the existing credit agreement in its entirety, with the new terms set forth in Annex I (not provided in the document). The purpose appears to be a general restructuring or update of the credit facility terms.
- MasterCraft Boat Holdings operates in the recreational boat manufacturing industry through its various subsidiary brands.

## 2. Investment Highlights & Risks

### Key Strengths / Credit Positives:
• Strong banking consortium led by JPMorgan Chase with established regional and national lenders, indicating continued lender confidence in the credit
• Comprehensive subsidiary guarantee structure across multiple boat manufacturing brands (MasterCraft, Nautic Star, Crest Marine, Aviara) providing enhanced credit support
• Borrower representations confirm no current defaults or events of default, suggesting good standing under existing credit terms
• Amendment includes a comprehensive release and waiver provision, indicating resolution of any prior issues or disputes

### Principal Risks and Mitigating Factors:
• Limited visibility into specific amended terms as the detailed credit agreement provisions are contained in the referenced but not provided Annex I
• The comprehensive nature of the amendment (amending "in its entirety") suggests potentially significant changes to the original credit structure
• Without access to pricing, covenant, or maturity details, full credit assessment is constrained
